name: map_enter
comment: map screens: cursor from profile +0x1FB (x2) on 0xE else 0; view (0x100 0xC0); map_zone_palettes

name: map_select
comment: map cursor = arg; moved flag +9 = 1 (state 0x03006230)

name: map_zone_palettes
comment: (not ported) the map's zone colours into the second base palette (unlock 0x118.. per zone)

name: map_draw
comment: (not ported) scrolls the map view towards the cursor and draws the map and its markers

name: number_text
comment: decimal text of n into a buffer (millions down; leading zeros dropped); remainders via the IWRAM divider

name: thousands_separator
comment: thousands separator for n > 999 (French space; German and Italian dot) inserted digits-3 from the left

name: time_text_colons
comment: mm:ss:cc of |centiseconds| capped at 0x57E3F

name: time_text
comment: time_text_colons then the last colon becomes a dot (fr de es) or comma (it)

name: hint_due
comment: (screen; event) 1 when a career hint (screen 0x28/0x2B) is due: hints seen +0x1F8+0x1F9 per zone and screen; clears +0x1FA

name: copy_results_to_ranked
comment: copies the 0x40-byte results 0x03005650 to the ranked copy 0x03005730

name: check_record_time
comment: new track record (profile +0x218) from the best lap of a finished known-mode race; flags +0x3B4 +0x4A8

name: draw_unlock_messages
comment: race results page 0xB: heading 0xD6 and the unlock texts in profile +0x4AA.. (0x31A skipped)

name: message_box_open
comment: (type; text; arg) opens a message box when none is open; swallows the keys; 1 if opened

name: page_script
comment: hint/story page script: sections [id; commands; 0xFFFF]; commands 0xFFF5..0xFFFD (sounds waits music flash grid pictures portraits)

name: tutorial_race_setup
comment: (0..2) one of the three tutorial races (career mode 2; car 5 with fixed upgrades; route 1 or 3); picks opponents

name: stop_music
comment: music id 0x0300003C = -1; snd_stop_music

name: fill_rect8
comment: (rect x0 y0 x1 y1; page; pitch; colour x 0x01010101) fills a rectangle of an 8bpp page (byte stores at odd edges)

name: text_box
comment: (font; text key or pointer; x; y; width; lines; colour) text in a box through FUN_08162B6C; key per language table

name: copy_mem
comment: (dst; src; bytes; width 0x20/0x10/8) forward copy in words/halfwords/bytes; nothing for null pointers

name: copy_words
comment: copies n words forward

name: copy_halfwords
comment: copies n halfwords forward

name: copy_bytes
comment: copies n bytes forward

name: fill_bg_palette
comment: (start; colour; count) BG palette entries from start set to colour

name: scale_obj_palette
comment: (source; r; g; b; first; n) OBJ palette entries = source channels x factor / 256 capped at 31

name: menu_scene_teardown
comment: every menu kind's exit handler: FUN_08139B7C(world)

name: garage_copy_car_record
comment: copies the car record of 0x03005718: bytes 0..6 to 0x03005700 and 7..16 to 0x03005707
